title: run/1.0 - the provenance of one CI run, deliberately NOT committed
$comment: Every field CI regenerates on every commit lives here and nowhere else. The artifacts this record names are committed and must be byte-identical across two runs of an unchanged environment, which is what `git diff --exit-code attest/` asserts; a `produced_at` inside one of them makes that gate red on every no-op commit, and a gate that is red on no-op commits is deleted within the week. This file is written to attest/run.json, gitignored, and attached as a release asset -- so the provenance is kept, in the one place where keeping it costs nothing.

produced_at.$comment: The single timestamp of the run. It is here, once, rather than repeated inside every artifact it produced.

ci.$comment: Null on a local run, and null is the honest value there -- a workstation has no run URL. It is NOT reported as an empty string, which would read as a URL nobody filled in.

files.$comment: What this run produced, by digest. This is the join back to the committed tree: a release asset naming attest/bundle.json by sha256 can be checked against the bundle.json in the tag without trusting anything in this file.
